    Dout, Hout, Wout,
    Cout, Cout_per_group,
    GROUPS, NUM_GROUP_BLOCKS,
    stride_d, stride_h, stride_w,
    pad_d, pad_h, pad_w,
    stride_xb, stride_xc, stride_xd, stride_xh, stride_xw,
    stride_wic, stride_woc, stride_wkd, stride_wkh, stride_wkw,
    stride_ob, stride_oc, stride_od, stride_oh, stride_ow,
    HAS_BIAS: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_HW: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_COUT: tl.constexpr,
    KD: tl.constexpr, KH: tl.constexpr, KW: tl.constexpr,
    CIN_PER_GROUP: tl.constexpr,
):
    pid = tl.program_id(0)
    HW = Hout * Wout
    NUM_HW_BLOCKS = (HW + BLOCK_HW - 1) // BLOCK_HW
    hw_block = pid % NUM_HW_BLOCKS
    tmp0 = pid // NUM_HW_BLOCKS
    od = tmp0 % Dout
    tmp = tmp0 // Dout
    gb = tmp % (GROUPS * NUM_GROUP_BLOCKS)
    b = tmp // (GROUPS * NUM_GROUP_BLOCKS)
    g = gb // NUM_GROUP_BLOCKS
    oc_block_in_group = gb % NUM_GROUP_BLOCKS
    oc_in_group = oc_block_in_group * BLOCK_COUT + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_COUT)
    oc = g * Cout_per_group + oc_in_group
    mask_oc = oc < Cout
    hw_offsets = hw_block * BLOCK_HW + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_HW)
    oh = hw_offsets // Wout
    ow = hw_offsets % Wout
    mask_hw = hw_offsets < HW
    b64 = b.to(tl.int64)
    od64 = od.to(tl.int64)
    oh64 = oh.to(tl.int64)
    ow64 = ow.to(tl.int64)
    g64 = g.to(tl.int64)
    oc64 = oc.to(tl.int64)
    oc_in_group64 = oc_in_group.to(tl.int64)
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_HW, BLOCK_COUT), dtype=tl.float32)
    for ic_local in range(CIN_PER_GROUP):
        ic = g64 * CIN_PER_GROUP + ic_local
        for kd in range(KD):
            id_num = od64 + pad_d - kd
            id_val = id_num // stride_d
            id_valid = (id_num % stride_d == 0) & (id_val >= 0) & (id_val < D)
            for kh in range(KH):
                ih_num = oh64 + pad_h - kh
                ih_val = ih_num // stride_h
                ih_valid = (ih_num % stride_h == 0) & (ih_val >= 0) & (ih_val < H)
                for kw in range(KW):
                    iw_num = ow64 + pad_w - kw
                    iw_val = iw_num // stride_w
                    iw_valid = (iw_num % stride_w == 0) & (iw_val >= 0) & (iw_val < W)
                    valid = mask_hw & id_valid & ih_valid & iw_valid
                    x_offset = (b64 * stride_xb + ic * stride_xc +
                                id_val * stride_xd + ih_val * stride_xh + iw_val * stride_xw)
                    x_val = tl.load(x_ptr + x_offset, mask=valid, other=0.0)
                    w_offset = (ic * stride_wic + oc_in_group64 * stride_woc +
                                kd * stride_wkd + kh * stride_wkh + kw * stride_wkw)

        bias_val = tl.load(bias_ptr + oc64, mask=mask_oc, other=0.0)
        acc += bias_val.to(tl.float32)[None, :]

                  oh64[:, None] * stride_oh + ow64[:, None] * stride_ow)
    store_mask = mask_hw[:, None] & mask_oc[None, :]
    tl.store(out_ptr + out_offset, acc, mask=store_mask)

    device = "cuda"

    K = 3
    stride_ = 1
    padding_ = 0
    output_padding_ = 0
    groups_ = 1
